title: feat(platform-objects): the Register SSO Provider form names the token, authorization and JWKS endpoints
body:
Fixes #33395

Clause-②: yes (widening) — the `register_sso_provider` action on `sys_sso_provider` gains three optional params, `authorizationEndpoint`, `tokenEndpoint` and `jwksEndpoint` (type `url`), and the object translation bundles gain their label and help-text keys. The register bridge already accepted all three; nothing accepted before is refused now.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Setup 里「注册 SSO 提供方」表单新增三个可选输入框:Token URL、Authorization URL、JWKS URL,与 Discovery URL / Userinfo URL 并列,按同名字段提交给注册桥接,落进 `oidcConfig`。
- 为什么改:Google 这类 IdP 的 token、密钥、userinfo 地址不在 issuer 的域名下,注册会因「不受信任的端点」被拒并提示填写这些字段;#33314 只让 API 入口收这些字段,表单里没有输入框,不会写代码的管理员仍然注册不了。
- 风险与回滚:只加三个可选表单参数,留空时什么都不发,已有注册行为不变;回滚即还原 `sys-sso-provider.object.ts` 并重新生成翻译包。
- 先看:`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-sso-provider.object.ts`(三个新参数与帮助文字);`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/register-sso-provider.test.ts`(新 describe:表单参数到 `oidcConfig` 的钉子);`content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/register-sso-provider.test.ts`,预期 43 个用例全绿,其中「the Setup form register_sso_provider names each endpoint …」两条通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Setup form.** `sys_sso_provider` action `register_sso_provider` gains optional **Authorization URL** (`authorizationEndpoint`), **Token URL** (`tokenEndpoint`) and **JWKS URL** (`jwksEndpoint`) params, type `url`, between `discoveryEndpoint` and `userInfoEndpoint` (the order of the bridge's own endpoint list). Each help text says the endpoint is kept instead of the one the discovery document names, is trusted for this provider, and is to be named when the registration is refused because the discovery document names that endpoint on a host the server does not trust; the token and JWKS texts give Google's URL as the example.
- **Bridge.** No change. `runRegisterSsoProviderFromForm` already carries all five named endpoints into `oidcConfig` by name (landed in #33314); the new params reach it under exactly those names, now pinned.
- **Translations.** Regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write --filter=platform-objects` (no hand edit). The translated locales carry the English text for the six new keys until translated.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx` names the four endpoint fields of the Setup form and says a Google registration can fill Token URL, JWKS URL and Userinfo URL there.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/33395-sso-form-named-endpoints.md`, `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch.

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/register-sso-provider.test.ts`, new top-level describe "the Setup form register_sso_provider names each endpoint under the oidcConfig member the bridge carries it to": (1) the form's `url` params are exactly the five endpoints the bridge takes, each optional; (2) every `url` param the form posts, driven through `runRegisterSsoProviderFromForm`, arrives in `oidcConfig` under its own name. It reads the action from `@objectstack/platform-objects` (resolved through `dist/`), so it crosses the form-to-bridge seam.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/platform-objects.test.ts`: the existing param-list pin now lists the three new params, and the trusted-endpoint help-text check covers all five endpoints.

## Acceptance notes

- Nothing beyond this card's scope.
